nodes.name: Bandit Perimeter & Sentry Palisade
nodes.customNotes: Sharpened wooden stakes and guard platforms where sentries demand the secret recognition password.

nodes.name: Black Talon Archer Encampment
nodes.customNotes: Elite human longbowmen in leather armors drill with poisoned iron broadheads over open cook fires.

nodes.customNotes: A massive furs-and-leather command pavilion guarded by Raemon, Venkt, and Britik, concealing letters detailing Cloakwood.
